# Venzix

> Venzix is a freelance web design and development studio in Chinnasalem, Tamil Nadu, India. It builds fast, mobile-first, SEO-ready websites for local businesses (shops, clinics, restaurants, salons, marriage halls, interior designers) across Chinnasalem, Salem, Villupuram, Kallakurichi, Namakkal, Erode and Chennai. Prices are fixed, one-time, in INR including GST.

Contact: +91 77082 01511 · infovenzix@gmail.com · https://venzix.vercel.app

## Packages (one-time, INR incl. GST)
- Starter ₹12,000: up to 5 pages, Google Business Profile setup, WhatsApp button, on-page SEO, 4–6 days
- Growth ₹28,000: up to 12 pages + blog, CMS, local SEO, Maps + Reviews, analytics, 7–12 days
- Pro ₹55,000: e-commerce or booking, Razorpay/UPI/COD, admin dashboard, 14–21 days
- Custom ₹1,00,000+: web apps, integrations, multi-location; quoted after a discovery call
Payment: 50% upfront, 50% on launch (Custom: milestones).
